title: A Joomla import whose account the Extension Manager refuses (403) stops as install_forbidden, not unreachable
steps: S1: Run the real joomla.installCowork (packages/site/tracy-add-site/src/host/joomla.ts) with a signed-in session, fetch mocked: com_config and com_installer&view=install both answer 403 'You do not have permission to view this resource.'
S2: Read the result and the recorded requests.
expect: S1: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'install_forbidden' }.
S2: every recorded request is a GET; no install was posted.

selectors.code: joomla.installCowork install_forbidden, refusal.tsx IMPORT_ERRORS, strings.ts import_error_install_forbidden

evidence: Production 19/10/2026, energy-solutions24.de (Joomla 6.2.0): signed in as an Administrator who is not a Super User, run mvf6rwylq0f3c2 failed 2.5 s later as installing / unreachable; the Extension Manager answers 403 to that account
fence: The Extension Manager read in installCowork: a 403 there names the account's missing permission instead of an unreachable site

tests: an account the Extension Manager refuses (403) is install_forbidden, not unreachable
